recommended_lenses.rationale: DESIGN §8.3 explicitly states a lexical/enumerated scan cannot be the certification mechanism, yet the highest-value invariants (honesty, fragment allowlist, protected surface, path/package gates) are all enforced by one-fixture-per-known-class. Enumeration is only sound if the complement is provably empty over a closed allowlist — which the spec never proves. This is the reward-hack heart of an assurance tool.
focus_areas: INV-024 bypass set must be derived as (INV-020 allowlist intersect full DESIGN §8.3 class list), with an exhaustiveness argument over the closed fragment, not a hand-picked list
honesty scan recurses into nested proof blocks (assert-by, calc hints, forall bodies) — the assert Post by { assume false; } bypass through an allowed edit class
INV-020/INV-015/INV-019/INV-008 test the ALLOWLIST complement (reject-by-construction), not an enumerated blocklist
real-producer dafny audit fixture that reports a finding at exit-0 (exit-status-only check is fail-open)
recommended_lenses.severity_guidance: CRITICAL if any in-fragment construct can produce a proposition/assumption not scanned, or if a bypass reaches certification; HIGH if the enforcement is enumerated with no closure proof; MEDIUM if closure is argued but a fixture class is missing.
recommended_lenses.source_finding_summary: INV-024 honesty policy enumerated; DESIGN §8.3 says enumeration cannot certify; nested-assume + audit-exit-0 + subset-of-§8.3 bypasses.

recommended_lenses.rationale: Multiple fail-closed guarantees are structurally unreachable in the shipping state: the readiness gate's READY-rejection branch is dead code (committed block is BLOCKED-all-false), the predicate's empty-set conjuncts pass when the finder never ran, and the completed-phase plan is self-declared. A guard whose rejecting branch never executes is AP-002 with green coverage.
focus_areas: INV-002 rejection + evidence-re-derivation path exercised via SUPPLIED/synthetic READY blocks, not only the committed file
INV-027 empty-negative conjuncts (unapproved_logical_assumptions=∅) gated on a positive attestation + honesty_policy_executed, never a default-empty pass
INV-030 expected-phase set derived from the immutable lock, never self-declared
every 'fail-closed' invariant has a negative fixture that FAILS when the guard is removed (AP-010 precondition assertion)
recommended_lenses.severity_guidance: CRITICAL if a fail-closed branch can never execute in any test (dead code) or an empty/absent set is read as pass; HIGH if the branch is reachable only after a real precondition discharges; MEDIUM if reachable but under-fixtured.
recommended_lenses.source_finding_summary: INV-002 READY-rejection branch is dead code as specified; empty-set-means-pass; self-declared plan.

recommended_lenses.rationale: The readiness gate claims bootstrappability from clean, but 'clean checkout' is not clean (committed spikes/dafny-compat/out/ ships in every clone), and the claim silently assumes every probe degrades to satisfied=false rather than throwing on an absent artifact — while two of three artifacts do not exist yet. This is the exact PMB-002/AP-021 circular-gate class the project already hit.
focus_areas: define clean = git clone PLUS rm -rf out; stop committing out/; bind own-product probes to RunContext not on-disk prior-run roots
pin and test: every evidence probe returns satisfied=false with a typed reason (never throws/skips) when its target artifact is absent or pending
P2 completion-manifest resolver and P3 lane probe exercised against a MISSING-artifact fixture from a fresh clone
OQ-005: P2/DF-003 discharge must not require regenerating frozen spike evidence that cannot reconverge (a freeze with no affordance is AP-005)
recommended_lenses.severity_guidance: HIGH if a probe can pass on committed leaked state or throw from clean; HIGH if P2 is structurally undischargeable; MEDIUM if the from-clean contract is unstated but no concrete leak path exists.
recommended_lenses.source_finding_summary: Committed out/ means clone != clean; absent-evidence-must-not-throw unpinned; OQ-005 frozen-evidence deadlock.

recommended_lenses.rationale: Every reproducibility/assurance claim (receipt core, fingerprints, vacuity) rests on determinism the spec under-scopes: EA-003 covers only resource units, the pinned solver seed is omitted from the locked plan, JCS does not order arrays, and P3's determinism runner may be a different platform than the shipped RID. Determinism claims are unfalsifiable by two-run sampling.
focus_areas: INV-022 must include the pinned solver seed(s) as a fixed, receipt-recorded element (DESIGN pins random seeds; the spec omits them)
INV-028 receipt core as an ALLOWLIST of normative-tagged fields (deny-by-default), and every core array has a defined total order (no HashSet/Dictionary/parallel-LINQ enumeration)
INV-018/INV-039 determinism run over the accept corpus with process hash-seed perturbation, not a single-fixture repeat
P3/INV-018 runner RID bound to EA-001's built RID, or scoped differential-only in the residual ledger
recommended_lenses.severity_guidance: HIGH if an unpinned seed or unordered collection can change a receipt_core_digest, or determinism is attested on a non-shipped platform; MEDIUM if determinism is under-sampled but structurally ordered.
recommended_lenses.source_finding_summary: Solver seed omitted from locked plan; receipt-core blocklist + unordered arrays; P3 platform tension.

recommended_lenses.rationale: The release-provenance group pins the Cosign TOOL VERSION but not the verification IDENTITY (issuer/subject/key), enforces verify-before-run only in the reference-CI YAML (local certify has no gate), and lets core-equality be mistaken for authenticity. Whoever controls the trust root forges provenance a version-pinned Cosign accepts.
focus_areas: pin the Cosign verification identity (keyless issuer+subject, or public key + trust root), not just the tool version; mismatch fail-closed
make provenance a fail-closed precondition IN THE BINARY (verify a signed bootstrap attestation with a pinned key, non-recursive), not only a CI-config assertion
keyless-vs-key-backed Cosign mode declared, with its env/network/clock prerequisites (EA-006)
document that receipt-core equality is a reproducibility property, never a standalone trust token
recommended_lenses.severity_guidance: HIGH if provenance can be forged with a version-pinned-but-identity-unpinned verifier, or local certify has no provenance gate; MEDIUM for the core-equality-vs-authenticity documentation gap.
recommended_lenses.source_finding_summary: Pinned Cosign version != pinned trust anchor; local certify has no provenance gate; core-equality != authenticity.

recommended_lenses.rationale: The spec is rigorous on fail-closed correctness but consistently under-specifies the human-facing feedback on the far side of every fail-closed edge. 'Typed reason' is never pinned to a closed vocabulary with a human message and offending locus; non-success terminals carry no remediation class; the BLOCKED gate and honest-BLOCKED state emit no actionable message. INV-002's 'name the offending precondition' discipline is never generalized to the surfaces developers actually hit.
focus_areas: RejectionReason as a total closed-vocabulary schema {code, human_message, offending_locus}, added to INV-029's totality set
remediation_class on every non-success terminal (fix_infrastructure | raise_resource_limit_and_relock | fix_candidate | escalate_spec)
INV-036 actionable BLOCKED message + a readiness-status reporter rendering each precondition -> discharge -> evidence-state
corrected explain scope decision (human recovery renderer) — accept into scope or defer with the gap in the residual ledger
recommended_lenses.severity_guidance: Advisory lens (never gates progression). MEDIUM where a typed state is unactionable to the user who must recover from it; LOW for cosmetic message wording.
recommended_lenses.source_finding_summary: Typed reasons not a closed vocabulary; no remediation_class; BLOCKED gate/state emits no actionable message.
